quest.title: Growing Pains
quest.description: Little Lulu has been unhappy lately. She seems to be troubled by a certain something...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: When will it be ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No playtime today?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! No, playtime doesn't seem to come at all these days.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Little Meng's in a bad mood and prefers to sulk by himself, and Little Fei keeps disappearing all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: I asked Little Meng what's wrong, but he wouldn't tell me. They're both acting so strange these days, I honestly don't know what's gotten into them.

choices.text: Welcome to the grown-up world, kiddo.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Wait, so when you grow up you stop being happy? Then why do Little Meng and Little Fei want to grow up so bad...

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: I guess I'll just not grow up, then.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Anyway, we're getting sidetracked. I actually need your help with something.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Can you fetch something from Ying'er's place for me? We already talked about it, so she should have it ready by now.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Yay! Thanks!

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: I don't know what you're thinking about, but it's not that. I just asked Ying'er to make something for me. And she said she would.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: And now I'm asking you very nicely to help collect it for me.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Me? No, I'm okay. But... I do need your help with something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does 3,000 Mora sound?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Wow, someone's desperate... Alright then, I will prioritize Lulu's perfume for the sake of our friendship.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I have to watch the shop during the day, though. My personal affairs are best dealt with at night.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Swing by tonight and I'll have everything ready for you.

talks.objective: Talk to Ying'er and obtain the perfume

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: The perfume is ready. A bespoke variety made with Mint Essential Oil.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Here you go. It's ready for Little Lulu now.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: It counteracts some of the more... hmm, stimulating elements with its neutral scent...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: To be honest, I was very surprised to receive an order from Lulu.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: It does make me reminisce about being that age, when one has one's first taste of love, oh how it makes the heart flutter... If only I had been a little more worldly wise back then...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Ahem... Anyway, I should let you get back to Lulu.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Hi, did you get my perfume?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Thank you! Ying'er makes the best perfume ever.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: I wonder what Little Meng and Little Fei will do when they smell it...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: I think that however they react, it will be a lot of fun to watch.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Hope so. That would be the best.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Thanks for helping me. I'll go home soon and have a go of my new perfume.

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: If it's good, then I can keep using it again and again.

choices.text: Who do you prefer to play with?

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Hmm? I don't prefer either of them... I prefer both of them! Little Meng and Little Fei are both my best friends.

talks.objective: Wait for Ying'er to decoct the perfume

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Here you are, one bespoke Mint perfume made specially for Lulu by yours truly. You can take it to her now.

choices.text: What did Lulu want this for?

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: She didn't tell me, and I didn't ask her.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: No girl is without her secrets. Keeping some things hidden, displaying a penchant for tact, it's all part of a girl's charm.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Alright, off you go now, get this back to Lulu.

talks.objective: Give the perfume to Little Lulu

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Why the hurry? I'm afraid being desperate in and of itself can't bring you what you want.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Well hello again. Missing me already, huh? What are you here for this time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: To pick something up for Little Lulu.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Little Lulu? ...Oh yes, that's right. She asked me to make some perfume for her.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: But I'm afraid this isn't the best time... For some reason, since you were last here, my sweet-smelling side services have been in exceptionally high demand.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I've had an enormous number of orders. It's far too many for me to handle alone, especially since I also have the shop to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: On top of that, Lulu's just a child. It would be a little inappropriate to give her the same type of perfume worn by adult women.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: So I was racking my brains trying to think of a way to make my perfume more child-friendly. I've now decided on a suitable formula, but I haven't got around to making it yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: If it absolutely can't wait, expediting it would not be impossible, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help out.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Not a bad idea. You do have some experience in these matters, after all. Well, you certainly impressed me last time you were here. *giggle*

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: As it happens, I have some of the necessary ingredients on hand. I'll go set up in Chef Mao's kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Go pick three leaves of Mint, then extract the essential oil at a Crafting Bench. I'm sure you're still intimately acquainted with the technique?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Bring the Mint Essential Oil to me, I'll handle the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How does 3,000 Mora sound?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Hmm, it seems you can't quite afford it.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Mint Essential Oil, you got it?

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: We did it together not long ago, you don't remember? Huh, so you're just as quick to forget as you are to get involved in the first place...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Let me give you a recap then. Go fetch three leaves of Mint, then extract the essential oil at a Crafting Bench.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Bring the essential oil to me, and I will take it from there.

choices.text: What uses does Mint Essential Oil have?

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: How to put this... it neutralizes some of the more stimulating elements in the concoction.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: But more importantly, the scent is a good match for a child like Lulu.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: A girl's scent is far more than a purely nasal affair...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: This perfume must capture Lulu's youthful lust for life, her wide-eyed innocence... *giggle*

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Mint is an appropriate scent for a child like Lulu.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I don't know why Lulu would have a need for perfume... But I suppose she is growing up.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: I don't know what's gotten into Little Meng and Little Fei recently...
